title: Potato I have
html_source:
Given to Bloom by his mother (Gifford). The potato crop failure in the 18th century led to devastation by famine and emmigration. A plight also present in Jewish history.

PROPOSED SUGGESTION: Can you expound on your point here? Not sure how your annotation connects with this line.
